description: This Java class 'MacroCommonRenderer' provides utility methods for rendering macros in the OFBiz framework, including creating AJAX parameter strings and resolving link URLs based on context and link type.

classes.name: MacroCommonRenderer
classes.description: Utility class for rendering macros, generating AJAX parameters, and resolving URLs within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: createAjaxParamsFromUpdateAreas
methods.description: Generates a CSV string of AJAX update area parameters based on a list of update areas, extra parameters, and context.

methods.name: buildParamStringFromMap
methods.description: Builds a URL-encoded parameter string from a map of parameters.

methods.name: getLinkUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a URL based on the link object, link type, and context, handling different link types such as 'update-area' and 'hidden-form'.
